asset.label: Hay Bale
asset.catalog_notes: Voxel square bale, 0.9 m by 0.5 m by 0.5 m at 0.05 m voxels, with straw runs along its length, three one-voxel twine wraps, rounded long edges and loose straws on top and on the grass. Proposed footprint is the bale's floor; the loose straws overhang it.
